title: Homework: measure and draw 10 angles
subject: Mathematics
unit: Summer 1: Geometric notation and constructions; geometric reasoning
source: Written for mathematics/y7 lesson 54 (Measure and draw 10 angles on the portal angle sheet (printable); estimate each one first.)
intro: Lesson 54 homework. Estimate each angle first, then measure it. Then draw the four angles in the table.

box.title: Draw G, H, I and J here

blocks.answers: A 28°, B 76°, C 104°, D 145°, E 170°, F 240° (reflex: measure 120° and take it from 360°); accept ± 2°. I: draw 160° and mark the outside; J: draw 45° and mark the outside.
